cards.name: Test the Waters
printedLines: {icon:e1c34ea8a2} I
12 Test the Waters
Now that the waters of the cove
have receded, it’s high time you
ventured there and collected a good
deal of samples. Not barnacles and dead fish mind
you, but the clues that will shed some light onto
what lives down there, and what threats you are
about to face in the imminent future...
SPECIAL RULES
Set aside Room Cards {icon:0db3807e84} 2 , {icon:0db3807e84} 5 , and
{icon:0db3807e84} 8 , when entering an Objective Room,
draw one of those cards at random. When
a Hero is in an Area {icon:9120cba1df} A of an Objective
Room, they can spend 2 actions to gather
a sample. Keep track of the samples by
placing Wounds on the Quest Card. The
Quest Card can not have more than 6 {icon:4d5b975539} .
XP
1 Xp/ 2 samples.

cards.name: Deep Waters
printedLines: {icon:e1c34ea8a2} I
8 Deep Waters
It’s time you mapped out more
of the underground network
deep in the coves.
Swim to the submerged grotto and there
you’ll find an entrance to the vast caverns.
Explore as much as you can and map out
the area carefully. No one knows what
lurks down there.
SPECIAL RULES
Always initiate battle in Curio Rooms.
XP
1 Xp/ 2 Rooms cleared.

cards.name: Deep Horrors
printedLines: {icon:e1c34ea8a2} I
12 Deep Horrors
It all starts with a threat known
as the Uca Major. A malevolent
eldritch nightmare that ravages the depths
of the cove. Head down there and finds its
lair, and deliver us from this evil crustacean
horror’s influence.
SPECIAL RULES
Objective Rooms always spawn
1 Uca Major first and then the
rest of the Monsters from the
Monster Deck as normal.
XP
1 Xp/ Uca Major killed.

cards.name: Unclean Waters
printedLines: {icon:e1c34ea8a2} I
12 Unclean Waters
The murky waters of the cove
didn’t used to be as such. The
mere presence of its unholy denizens
threatens our very own existence. If you
don’t put an end to them, it’s going to turn
into a fetid pool of virulent sickness. Head
down there and clean the fetid lair. Halt
the contamination for good.
SPECIAL RULES
When a Hero kills a Cove
Monster they suffer 2 {icon:c491fb0b8e} 3t.
XP
1 Xp/ Lair cleared.

cards.name: Purify the Eldritch Signs
printedLines: {icon:e1c34ea8a2} I
12 Purify the Eldritch Signs
The emerging threat from the cove
can mean only one thing, that the
eldritch signs etched to the grotto’s
walls have been corrupted. Take these potions and
imbue them once more with the arcane energy
they require. Keep them active, to protect us from
the evil that resides down there.
SPECIAL RULES
Set aside Room Cards {icon:0db3807e84} 1 and {icon:0db3807e84} 9 .
When entering an Objective Room,
draw one of those cards at random
and at the end of the encounter set it
aside again. At the start of the Quest
you can turn any Provision to {icon:dfb88662b8} . Once
per battle, when a Hero is in an Area {icon:9120cba1df}
of an Objective Room they can discard
a Potion to purify the Eldritch Sign.
XP
1 Xp/ Eldritch Sign purified.
